title: Natural ambient self-Tor coordinates on affine section modules
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-pc-scheme], with the canonical derived category and tensor [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure], and let $n\geq0$. Put $B=i_*\mathcal O_Z$ and $Q=H^{-n}(B[0]\otimes^{\mathbf L}B[0])$. For every affine open $U$, put $A_U=\Gamma(Y,U)$ and $I_U=\ker(i^\sharp)(U)$. There exist $A_U$-linear equivalences $c_U:\operatorname{Tor}^{A_U}_n(A_U/I_U,A_U/I_U)\simeq\Gamma(U,Q)$, using the left-derived right-tensor convention. If $V\subseteq U$ is basic, $\varphi:A_U\to A_V$ is restriction and $\psi:A_U/I_U\to A_V/I_V$ commutes with quotient maps, let $P,R$ be the chosen projective resolutions, $a:P\to\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}R$ an augmented comparison inducing $\psi$, and $k:P\otimes_{A_U}(A_U/I_U)\to\operatorname{Res}_{\varphi}(R\otimes_{A_V}(A_V/I_V))$ a chain map satisfying $k_j(x\otimes y)=a_j(x)\otimes\psi(y)$ for all $j,x,y$. Let $q$ be its homology map, transported through the exact restriction-of-scalars homology isomorphism and the two ProjectiveResolution.isoLeftDerivedObj isomorphisms. Then $\operatorname{res}_{U,V}(c_U(x))=c_V(q(x))$ for every $x$. This is a statement about section modules; it asserts no chart sheaf isomorphism.

source.place: Tag 08DX(2), lemma-quasi-coherence-tensor-product, with 06YG (K-flat computation) and 00LS (comparison homotopies)

proof.text: Obtain affine section equivalences d_U on the homology of the chosen quotient tensor complex, compatible with one augmented localized comparison for each basic inclusion. Compose d_U with the linear equivalence induced by ProjectiveResolution.isoLeftDerivedObj to construct c_U on algebraic self-Tor.

For any supplied quotient map psi, use surjectivity of the quotient projection to identify it with the chosen quotient map. Apply the quotient tensor resolution lift homotopy theorem to the supplied and chosen augmented maps. Homotopy.homologyMap_eq then identifies their homology maps.

Evaluate the chosen naturality equation at the image under isoLeftDerivedObj.hom of the Tor class. Cancel the target isoLeftDerivedObj.hom after its inverse using Iso.inv_hom_id. Substitute equality of homology maps to obtain exactly the required equation with q. This is implemented using ModuleCat.comp_apply and concrete evaluation of the inverse identity.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_selfTor_ambient_section_coordinates
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (n : ℕ) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let Q :=
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (-(n : ℤ))).obj
          (S.obj B ⊗ S.obj B))
    ∃ c : ∀ U : Y.affineOpens,
        ((tensorRight (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
          ((Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) ⧸ i.ker.ideal U))).leftDerived n).obj
          (ModuleCat.of (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
            ((Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) ⧸ i.ker.ideal U)) ≃ₗ[Γ(Y, U.1)]
              Q.val.obj (op U.1),
      ∀ (V U : Y.affineOpens) (h : V.1 ≤ U.1)
        (_hbasic : ∃ f : Γ(Y, U.1), Y.basicOpen f = V.1),
          let A := (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u)
          let C := (Γ(Y, V.1) : Type u)
          let I := i.ker.ideal U
          let J := i.ker.ideal V
          let φ := (Y.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op).hom
          let P := projectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))
          let R := projectiveResolution (ModuleCat.of C (C ⧸ J))
          let TA := (tensorRight (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.down ℕ)
          let TC := (tensorRight (ModuleCat.of C (C ⧸ J))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.down ℕ)
          ∀ (ψ : (A ⧸ I) →+* (C ⧸ J))
            (a : P.complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.down ℕ)).obj R.complex)
            (k : TA.obj P.complex ⟶ ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.down ℕ)).obj (TC.obj R.complex)),
            (∀ x : A, ψ (Ideal.Quotient.mk I x) = Ideal.Quotient.mk J (φ x)) →
            (∀ x : P.complex.X 0, R.π.f 0 (a.f 0 x) = ψ (P.π.f 0 x)) →
            (∀ (j : ℕ) (x : P.complex.X j) (y : A ⧸ I),
              k.f j (x ⊗ₜ[A] y) = (show R.complex.X j from a.f j x) ⊗ₜ[C] (ψ y)) →
            let e := ((TC.obj R.complex).sc n).mapHomologyIso
              (ModuleCat.restrictScalars φ)
            let q := fun x ↦
              (R.isoLeftDerivedObj (tensorRight (ModuleCat.of C (C ⧸ J))) n).inv
                (e.hom (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap k n
                  ((P.isoLeftDerivedObj (tensorRight (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))) n).hom x)))
          ∀ x, Q.val.map (homOfLE h).op (c U x) = c V (q x)
